lead_headline: Astro ships two releases and queues four more PRs as build-option inheritance and Cloudflare SSR gaps close
lead_body: Astro pushed astro@6.3.6 and @astrojs/cloudflare@13.5.3 before noon, then spent the afternoon closing gaps in Vite build-option inheritance and Cloudflare SSR optimizeDeps forwarding. Four PRs opened in the evening — covering prerendered stylesheet manifests, forwarded headers, worker-name normalization, and remote image domain gating — setting up a heavy merge queue tomorrow.
lead_article:
The headline today belongs to Astro, which pushed two releases before noon — astro@6.3.6 and @astrojs/cloudflare@13.5.3 — and kept moving through the afternoon. The Vite build options inheritance fix merged, ensuring client builds now respect vite.build.minify, sourcemap, and rollup output options properly; separately, optimizeDeps forwarding landed for SSR environments in the Cloudflare adapter. A revert of PR 16708 arrived in the same window, and triage rules were added to prevent server timeout loops. Four PRs opened in the evening — external stylesheet URL population for prerendered routes, X-Forwarded-* header resolution in FetchState, a wrangler.jsonc worker name normalization, and an error-throwing gate for non-allowed remote image domains — suggesting tomorrow's merge queue will be heavy.

Workflow SDK had two quiet but substantive movements: the Nitro v3 functionRules refactor merged, and a new PR opened for presigned S3 URLs with parallel event-log loading — a meaningful infrastructure step. Hydrogen shed a couple of exports and moved custom typings to global scope. The AI SDK gained an abort-signal propagation fix for telemetry error callbacks. Claude Code spent the day absorbing a surge of bug reports — TUI corruption, session-resume model-name mangling, a Telegram plugin CPU loop on EPIPE, plugin install false negatives — with four issues closed against the noise. Two PRs opened there: a docs polish on the plugins README and a PR addressing excessive token consumption on initial prompts.
